verdict.rationale: Temporal documents a programmatic Client API for starting, listing, querying, signaling and fetching results of Workflow Executions (temporal-docs-50). Workflows also act as stateful services with message handlers 'akin to endpoints' (temporal-docs-38, temporal-docs-6), and the CLI gives direct access to the Temporal Service (temporal-docs-42). Service Accounts & API Keys support non-human access (temporal-docs-20, temporal-docs-27). Missing for 10: no published OpenAPI/REST spec (all probe paths 404), no evidenced wire-level API reference beyond SDK client docs, and no independent hands-on corroboration of driving it programmatically.
